cues.zh: 我本来想讲渲染，但其实这是上个视频里我忘了提的内容
cues.en: I was going to talk about rendering but actually this is something I forgot to mention in the last video

cues.zh: 你可能会觉得双曲几何比球面几何更难理解，因为它更难可视化
cues.en: You'd think that hyperbolic geometry is harder to understand than spherical because it's harder to visualize

cues.zh: 这没错，但就你实际看到的东西而言，情况恰恰相反
cues.en: And that's true, but when it comes to what you actually see, it's quite the opposite

cues.zh: 总的来说，双曲几何看起来像是一种更
cues.en: In general hyperbolic geometry looks like a more

cues.zh: 夸张的欧几里得几何
cues.en: exaggerated euclidean geometry

cues.zh: 你知道，因为它是“双曲”的。东西看起来缩小得更快，同样的感知空间里能容纳更多空间
cues.en: You know because it's "hyperbolic". Things appear to get smaller faster more space fits into the same perceived space

cues.zh: 但整体上看起来还是很熟悉
cues.en: But things seem overall familiar

cues.zh: 不过，让我们去一趟球面平地
cues.en: But let's take a trip to spherical flatland

cues.zh: 我们就假设赤道以下都是地下，赤道以上都是开放空间
cues.en: We'll just say that everything below the equator is underground and everything above is open space

cues.zh: 这样我们就可以上下跳跃、四处走动
cues.en: So we can jump up and down and walk around

cues.zh: 事实上，如果我们一直朝任一方向走，最终都会回到起点
cues.en: In fact, if we keep walking in either direction, we'll eventually come back to where we started

cues.zh: 但你实际会看到什么呢？
cues.en: But what would you actually see?

cues.zh: 我们从自己的视角发射一些光线，看看它们最终落在哪里
cues.en: Let's cast some rays from our perspective to see where they end up

cues.zh: 近处的物体基本不受影响，看起来和你想的一样
cues.en: Objects close by aren't really affected much and look like you'd expect

cues.zh: 但另一侧的物体
cues.en: But an object on the other side

cues.zh: 看看有多少条光线打在这块石头上
cues.en: Well, look how many of our light rays hit this rock

cues.zh: 这个小小的物体，明明在世界另一端
cues.en: this tiny object literally on the other side of the world

cues.zh: 却会在天空中显得巨大，而且上下颠倒
cues.en: would look enormouIn the sky and appear upside down

cues.zh: 有点像一面巨大的放大镜
cues.en: Sort of like a giant magnifying lens

cues.zh: 结果就是反向透视，远处的物体反而比近处的显得更大
cues.en: The result is a reverse perspective farther away objects can appear larger than closer ones

cues.zh: 另外注意，所有光线最终都会打到地面上
cues.en: Also notice that all rays eventually hit the ground

cues.zh: 严格来说没有天空，至少在不使用雾或绘制距离时看不到
cues.en: There's no sky per se at least not when you can see without using fog or a draw distance

cues.zh: 好了，准备好再升一个维度了吗？
cues.en: Alright, are you ready to go up one dimension higher?

cues.zh: 我们现在切换到第一人称，但刚才讲的二维里的所有东西同样适用于三维
cues.en: We're going to switch to first person now, but all the same things. I just talked about in 2d apply to 3d

cues.zh: 现在应该很明显我为什么选这个视频标题了
cues.en: Should be pretty obvious now why I chose the title of this video

cues.zh: 反向透视很明显，远处的东西显得巨大而且上下颠倒
cues.en: The reverse perspective is obvious far away things appear huge and flipped upside down

cues.zh: 看看这栋房子，近距离看挺正常的
cues.en: Take a look at this house. It's pretty normal up close

cues.zh: 但现在，我们走到关卡的对面
cues.en: But now, let's go to the opposite side of the level

cues.zh: 效果相当疯狂，有点像房子被翻了个里外
cues.en: It's a pretty crazy effect it's kind of like the house is inside out

cues.zh: 屋顶在我们上方，墙壁环绕着我们，但不是你预期的那种方式
cues.en: The roof is above us and the walls are around us but not in the way you'd expect

cues.zh: 另外，如果你向左或向右走直线
cues.en: Also, if you walk in a straight line to the left or right

cues.zh: 看起来世界在旋转，尽管你其实是在直走
cues.en: it looks like the world is rotating even though you're actually going straight

cues.zh: 我在这里加了道围栏，把这一关分成两半
cues.en: Here I added a fence to divide the level in half

cues.zh: 这个效果真不错，你是被围在里面还是挡在外面？
cues.en: It's a really neat effect, are you fenced in or fenced out?

cues.zh: 总之，球面几何里有很多很酷的东西可以探索
cues.en: Anyway, there's a lot of really cool things to explore in spherical geometry

cues.zh: 等游戏发布后，我还想留一些东西给你们自己去发现
cues.en: and I still want to leave some things for you to discover When the game comes out

cues.zh: 所以记得把 Hyperbolica 加入你的 Steam 愿望单
cues.en: So be sure to add Hyperbolica to your steam wishlist

cues.zh: 或者订阅以获取最新更新
cues.en: or subscribe to get the latest updates

cues.zh: 我们下次见
cues.en: and i'll see you all next time
